config.experiment_title: A Comparative Study of CNN-LSTM and Vision Transformer Models for Real-Time Sign Language Recognition

metrics.latency_method: Mean per-clip model forward-pass time, batch latency divided by batch size; warm-up batches excluded; device synchronization used before and after timed batches. Video decoding and preprocessing are excluded. FPS = clips x sampled frames / summed model-only clip latency.

resources.peak_memory_method: Peak sampled process RSS on CPU or framework allocator/driver allocation on the selected accelerator; sampled every 100 ms. This is not system-wide memory.
